name: spaces_pin_asset
description: Pin one planning asset (character sheet, scenario, script) to the board: text node + optional creation visual + named panel, in ONE call. Idempotent upsert by title — re-pinning updates the existing pin, never duplicates. One call per asset; to refine, call again with the same title. @see guides_get('spaces')

content.description: Full asset markdown (sheet/script). Replaces previous content on update.

creationIdentifier.description: Chosen visual creation sqid. Added beside the text inside the panel.

title.description: Asset key, e.g. "Personaje — Lyra". Re-pin same title = update, not duplicate.
